rationale: FGA-to-SGA depot conversion targeting metabolic neutrality and QTc improvement. Aripiprazole LAI (Abilify Maintena) requires a mandatory 14-day oral aripiprazole overlap after the first injection because depot microspheres take ~2 weeks to reach therapeutic levels. The haloperidol decanoate depot tail (effective half-life ~21 days) provides D2 cover during both the oral overlap phase and beyond — there is no coverage gap. Risk of akathisia: aripiprazole's D2 partial agonism can precipitate akathisia when acting on a D2 receptor pool fully saturated by haloperidol. Counsel the patient early; if akathisia emerges consider propranolol 40 mg twice daily or a temporary low-dose benzodiazepine. QTc will improve as haloperidol clears. EPS, tardive movements and prolactin should normalise progressively over 3 months. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Skip next Haldol decanoate injection. Administer Abilify Maintena 400 mg IM (gluteal or deltoid). START oral aripiprazole 10 mg daily — 14-day overlap is MANDATORY. Haloperidol depot tail still providing D2 cover. Counsel patient about akathisia risk and to report inner restlessness early.

STOP oral aripiprazole today (14-day overlap complete). Abilify Maintena now therapeutic. Haloperidol depot clearing. Monitor akathisia — risk peaks in this phase as haloperidol full-antagonism recedes and aripiprazole partial agonism takes hold.
Second Maintena 400 mg injection. Haloperidol substantially cleared. Review akathisia, EPS, QTc and prolactin. Monthly Maintena thereafter.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: haloperidol decanoate 100 mg/4 weeks ≈ aripiprazole LAI 400 mg/4 weeks (Maudsley 15th, LAI equivalence). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
